channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: An Audi just set a new 831-mile EV range World Record
item.description: There’s a new EV range champion, as this Audi just traveled the equivalent of New York to Chicago on a single charge

item.title: HP debuts $7,449 Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 laptop — ZBook Ultra G3a has 192GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and can handle up to 300B parameters
item.description: HP’s ZBook Ultra G3a combines 192GB memory, AMD processing, integrated Radeon graphics, and substantial power for demanding local AI workloads.

item.title: Rebellion confirms Alien Deathstorm uses the same engine as Atomfall, but it's 'a more advanced version' that offers a new lighting system, 'which for an action horror game is actually a must'
item.description: Rebellion has confirmed that Alien Deathstorm was built on a new version of the Atomfall engine, which also let the team bring the horror aspect to life.

item.title: Affaire Cambridge Analytica | Facebook a trompé ses utilisateurs, juge un jury du Nouveau-Mexique
item.description: Un jury du Nouveau-Mexique a estimé vendredi que Facebook avait trompé les habitants de cet État américain sur l’utilisation de leurs données personnelles, dans un procès issu du scandale Cambridge Analytica, selon des médias américains.

item.title: How to stop Meta training its AI models on your smart glasses' visual data
item.description: The setting affects whether workers can review photos and videos from your glasses.

item.title: Meta opens early access program for new Muse features
item.description: Anyone interested in joining has to ask Muse to put them on the list.

item.title: The hottest new hangout for middle schoolers is NPR’s comment section?
item.description: When NPR staffers flagged strange comments under their podcasts on Spotify as bots, it took a Gen Z colleague to (immediately) figure out the mystery.

item.title: Thieves Stole ‘Nvidia’ Trailers. They Got 20 Tons of Sand
item.description: They wanted the silicon. They got the sand.

item.title: New Mexico jury rules Meta misled state residents about data privacy
item.description: The company is still paying for the Cambridge Analytica scandal.
